# Live API Hub

> A verified directory of free public APIs, mobile agents, agent skills, and free LLM gateways — 260 entries across 36 categories, all link-checked live and tagged by free tier (178 fully free, 65 freemium, 17 paid). Built for phone-first builders: every entry works from a phone (Termux/Android) or a browser, with no PC needed.

Generated from data/apis.json (v0.6.9, updated 2026-11-20). The canonical machine-readable copy is https://dmdot714-cmd.github.io/Live-api-hub/data/apis.json — fetch that for structured access; this file is the human- and agent-readable listing. Data is MIT-licensed and re-verified weekly (dead entries are removed).

## Advice (1)

- **Advice Slip** (free, No auth) — Random life advice, one slip at a time. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://api.adviceslip.com/ Try it: https://api.adviceslip.com/advice

## Agent For Android (13)

- **AiCode** (free, No auth) — AI coding agent for Android — built-in Alpine Linux container, terminal, code editor and Git; MCP support, sub-agents and skills. Free tier: Free, open-source (GPL-3.0); Android APK from GitHub releases; model-agnostic — bring your own key, works with OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini-compatible endpoints incl. free gateways. Docs: https://github.com/jieapi/AiCode
- **Android Ad Cleaner** (free, No auth) — Switch off system ads, hot-search, news recommendations and marketing pushes on Chinese-brand Android phones (Vivo, OPPO, Xiaomi, Honor, OnePlus, Realme) — no root, no PC, fully reversible. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); Android 11+ APK; README is Chinese-language. Docs: https://github.com/rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner
- **AutoGLM For Android** (free, No auth) — Native Android phone-use agent based on Open-AutoGLM — control your phone with natural language, no PC or ADB needed (uses Shizuku). Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); Android 7.0+; multi-model — any OpenAI-format vision-capable API, incl. free gateways; needs the Shizuku app for system permissions. Docs: https://github.com/Luokavin/AutoGLM-For-Android
- **ChatBox** (free, No auth) — Multi-provider AI client for Android (and desktop) — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter and more in one app, keys stored on-device. Free tier: Free, open-source (GPL-3.0, Community Edition); Google Play + APK; free with your own API key, incl. free gateways; optional hosted plans from $3.99/mo. Docs: https://github.com/chatboxai/chatbox
- **Concat** (free, No auth) — Free open-source local-first video editor — auto-captions, TTS + voice cloning, background removal, keyframes, 4K export; scriptable via JSON-RPC API & MCP. No watermark, no account, no subscription. Free tier: Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0); Android 8.0+ APK, 4 GB RAM min; Beta — phone TTS/voice-cloning features lag desktop. Docs: https://github.com/jub0t/Concat
- **DSH-Android** (free, No auth) — DeepSeek Harness as a single Android APK — operates apps, files and system settings, with automation triggers and a built-in Linux environment; no root or Termux. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); unofficial community port, no DeepSeek affiliation; DeepSeek account or API key, plus OpenRouter/GLM/Qwen or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; Play Protect may flag the APK — verify SHA-256. Docs: https://github.com/jackwener/DSH-Android
- **Locus** (free, No auth) — Local-first AI agent for Android — Alpine Linux shell, agent browser, MCP and sub-agents; bring any model, no Locus account or server. Free tier: Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0); APK from GitHub releases; any OpenAI-compatible server, ChatGPT plan, or on-device Gemma/GGUF; Android 8.0+; very new project (Oct 2026). Docs: https://github.com/springmusk026/locus
- **Mika** (free, No auth) — On-device AI agent that operates your apps and the web from one sentence — works on a hidden background screen while you keep using your phone. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); APK from GitHub releases; 20+ providers incl. OpenRouter, Groq and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; Android 12+ for app control (14+ recommended); early public beta. Docs: https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika
- **OpenClaw App** (free, No auth) — OpenClaw AI gateway as a standalone Android app — Flutter UI with built-in terminal and web dashboard, one-tap setup, no root (Ubuntu via proot). Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); APK from GitHub releases; multi-model via the OpenClaw gateway — works with free gateways; Android 10+. Docs: https://github.com/mithun50/openclaw-termux
- **Plain App** (free, No auth) — Manage your Android phone from any browser on the same Wi-Fi — files, SMS, calls, photos, screen mirror. 100% local, no account, no cloud. Free tier: Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0); free and ad-free, no purchases or upsells. Docs: https://github.com/plainhub/plain-app
- **PocketPal AI** (free, No auth) — Private on-device AI assistant — chat with GGUF models (Gemma, Qwen, Phi, Llama) fully offline, with voice, tools and Hugging Face model downloads. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); Google Play + GitHub APK; runs small models on-device only — no cloud models; optional PocketPal Plus purchase in store builds, included free in the GitHub APK. Docs: https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai
- **RikkaHub** (free, No auth) — Native Android LLM client with a proot Linux agent workspace and Phone Use — the AI operates your phone; MCP, Skills and web search built in. Free tier: Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0); Google Play + website APK; multi-provider — custom API/URL/models for any OpenAI/Google/Anthropic-compatible endpoint, incl. free gateways. Docs: https://github.com/rikkahub/rikkahub
- **VoiceStudio** (free, No auth) — Free open-source voice studio (ElevenLabs alternative) — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobooks in 646 languages, on-device and offline after model download; Android 10+ APK. Free tier: Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0); Android build is Preview; optional Pro plan (commercial licence + multi-device) — the AGPL app stays free. Docs: https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio

## Agent For Termux (22)

- **aichat** (free, No auth) — All-in-one LLM CLI: chat, shell assistant, RAG and agents across 20+ providers. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0/MIT); official Termux package: pkg install aichat; works with free gateways or local Ollama. Docs: https://github.com/sigoden/aichat
- **Aider** (free, No auth) — AI pair programming in the terminal — chat to edit real code, git-aware. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); pip install (heavy deps may need clang/rust); free via OpenAI-compatible gateways (OpenRouter :free, OrcaRouter, Kilo) — add any API key. Docs: https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider
- **Codebase Memory MCP** (free, No auth) — Local code-intelligence MCP server: a persistent graph of code, docs and infra for agents. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); single static binary, no runtime deps. Docs: https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
- **Core Termux** (free, No auth) — One-script setup turning Termux into a dev workstation: AI coding agents, editor, databases, automation. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); built for Termux. Docs: https://github.com/DevCoreXOfficial/core-termux
- **DeepSeek Harness** (free, No auth) — DeepSeek's open-source agent harness (dsh): plugin-based coding agent with a phone web UI (127.0.0.1:3080) — works with any OpenAI-compatible model or gateway, not just DeepSeek. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); free via any free gateway (OrcaRouter, Kilo, LLM7); Termux install needs native modules compiled — community installer available (10-30 min). Docs: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
- **Fabric** (free, No auth) — Crowdsourced AI prompt patterns for the CLI — pipe text through an LLM with a chosen pattern. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); go install (Go is a Termux pkg); free via OpenAI-compatible gateways — add any API key. Docs: https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric
- **Freebuff** (free, No auth) — Free multi-agent coding assistant for the terminal — the open-source successor to Codebuff. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); npm install -g freebuff; no subscription, credits or API key needed — ad-supported free models. Docs: https://github.com/CodebuffAI/freebuff
- **Goose** (free, No auth) — Extensible AI agent for code and workflows — desktop app, CLI and API, works with 15+ providers. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); official Termux support — install script auto-picks the musl aarch64 build; works with local Ollama or OpenRouter free models. Docs: https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose
- **gptme** (free, No auth) — Terminal agent with local tools — writes code, uses the shell, browses the web; build persistent agents on top. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); pip install gptme; free via OpenRouter :free models or any OpenAI-compatible gateway. Docs: https://github.com/gptme/gptme
- **Hermes Agent** (free, No auth) — Self-improving AI agent by Nous Research — TUI, chat gateways, skills and memory; any model via OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, z.ai GLM or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); free via OpenRouter :free models or any free gateway — no Nous subscription needed. Termux install currently broken per official docs (fix in progress). Docs: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs
- **Kimi Code** (free, No auth) — Moonshot AI's terminal coding agent — reads/edits code, runs shell commands, MCP and subagents. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); npm install -g @moonshot-ai/kimi-code (needs Node 22.19+); free via any OpenAI-compatible gateway — default Kimi models need a paid membership. Docs: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code
- **LLM** (free, No auth) — CLI for chatting with LLMs, with plugins for Gemini, Ollama and OpenAI-compatible models. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); pip install llm; works with free gateways or local Ollama. Docs: https://github.com/simonw/llm
- **Ollama** (free, No auth) — Run LLMs locally on the phone — the free offline backend for aichat, llm and other CLIs. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); official Termux package: pkg install ollama. Docs: https://github.com/ollama/ollama
- **Open Interpreter** (free, No auth) — Coding agent optimized for low-cost and local models — runs Python, shell and JS on your machine from natural language. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); install script ships an aarch64 musl binary; free via 117 hosted providers or any OpenAI-compatible gateway. Docs: https://github.com/openinterpreter/openinterpreter
- **OpenClaw** (free, No auth) — Personal AI agent gateway — assistant in your chats, on your own devices, with shell tools and MCP. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); npm install -g openclaw (needs Node 22+); free via OpenRouter :free models or any OpenAI-compatible gateway. Docs: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw
- **OpenClaw for Android** (free, No auth) — Automated installer for the OpenClaw agent system on Android via Termux. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); installer script sets up OpenClaw in a Debian proot on Termux; needs 4GB+ RAM. Docs: https://github.com/iyeoh88-svg/openclaw-android
- **OpenCode** (free, No auth) — The open-source AI coding agent for the terminal. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); runs in Termux via the opencode-termux build; 13 free models built in (GLM-5.3-Flash Free, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free) + 75+ providers via API key. Docs: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode
- **OpenCode for Termux** (free, No auth) — Native aarch64 build of OpenCode for Termux — the key enabler for agents on the phone. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); standalone zip, pacman or .deb from releases; needs ripgrep. Docs: https://github.com/guysoft/opencode-termux Use cases: Coding agent in Termux — run OpenCode natively on the phone, no PC; Free AI coding — 13 free models built in, no API key needed. Install (deb): curl -LO https://github.com/guysoft/opencode-termux/releases/latest/download/opencode_1.17.9_aarch64.deb; dpkg -i opencode_1.17.9_aarch64.deb; pkg install ripgrep | Runtime: none — standalone aarch64 binary | Requires: Termux on Android aarch64; ripgrep | First run: opencode | Note: Standalone zip and pacman routes are also in the README. v2 pre-release installs side by side as opencode2. Plain npm install of opencode does NOT work in Termux — use this build.
- **Pi** (free, No auth) — Minimal, extensible terminal coding agent — four tools, mid-session model switching, add only what you need. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (needs Node 22.19+); free via OpenRouter :free models (dedicated provider) or local Ollama. Docs: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi
- **ShellGPT** (free, No auth) — Shell assistant: natural language to shell commands, plus chat and code modes. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); pip install shell-gpt; free via OpenAI-compatible gateways through the LiteLLM extra — add any API key. Docs: https://github.com/TheR1D/shell_gpt
- **Termux MCP** (free, No auth) — Early-stage MCP server for Termux — lets AI agents run shell commands on the Android device. Free tier: Free, open-source (AGPL-3.0); built for Termux (Python); small/new project. Docs: https://github.com/termuxgpt/termux-mcp
- **tgpt** (free, No auth) — Free AI chatbots in the terminal — several backends need no API key. Free tier: Free, open-source (GPL-3.0); go install or prebuilt binary; some backends need no key. Docs: https://github.com/aandrew-me/tgpt

## Agent Skill (20)

- **Agency Agents** (free, No auth) — A complete AI agency in one repo — 200+ specialised agents (frontend, Reddit community, copywriting and more), each with personality, process and deliverables. Install a subset on a phone; the full set is heavy. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents
- **Agentic Awesome Skills** (free, No auth) — Catalog of 2,900+ installable SKILL.md playbooks with a local CLI, MCP server and planner for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); imported skills retain upstream licences — 1,836 index entries declare no licence; install from GitHub (npm publishing paused). Docs: https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills
- **agentmemory** (free, No auth) — Persistent memory for AI coding agents, built on real-world benchmarks; npm @agentmemory/agentmemory. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and more. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0). Docs: https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory
- **Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills** (free, No auth) — 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, NIST AI RMF and MITRE F3; 29 security domains. Community project — NOT affiliated with Anthropic. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0). Docs: https://github.com/mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
- **Archify** (free, No auth) — Agent skill turning an idea, plan or codebase into a verified, interactive, self-contained HTML architecture diagram (Mermaid, flow, sequence). Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); zero runtime deps beyond Node; works with OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor. Docs: https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify
- **Awesome Agent Skills** (free, No auth) — Curated collection of 1,000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and more. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); install by clone/copy skill folders or via skills.sh. Distinct from ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills. Docs: https://github.com/VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
- **Awesome Claude Skills** (free, No auth) — Curated list of 1000+ production-ready Claude Skills and plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more — includes the Competitive Ads Extractor and Invoice Organizer skills. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0 per README; individual skills may differ). Docs: https://github.com/ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
- **Diagram Design** (free, No auth) — Editorial diagram design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Pi and more — 45 diagram types as self-contained HTML + SVG, no Mermaid. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design
- **ECC** (free, No auth) — Everything Claude Code — 311 skills, 71 agents, hooks and rules forming a full engineering workflow (plan, test, implement, review, verify, remember) for 19 hosts incl. OpenCode. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); full install adds ~27k tokens of standing context; ECC Pro (hosted GitHub App) is paid but the toolkit is not gated. Docs: https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC
- **ffmpeg-skill** (free, No auth) — Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools (cut, captions/karaoke, reframe, loudness, platform exports) + MCP server — no cloud, no API keys. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); needs ffmpeg 6.1+ and python3 on PATH (pkg install ffmpeg python); encoding is slow on a phone. Docs: https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill Use cases: YouTube video making — cut, caption, reframe and export videos locally on the phone; Video editing for agents — 42 FFmpeg tools, no cloud, no API keys. Install (npx): pkg install ffmpeg python; npx ffmpeg-skill --codex; npx ffmpeg-skill doctor | Runtime: Node.js for npx; ffmpeg 6.1+ and python3 on PATH | Requires: none — no API keys; captions need pip install faster-whisper (optional, runs locally) | First run: ask the agent to edit a video, e.g. cut interview.mp4 to a 60-second Reel | Note: Encoding is slow on a phone. --codex installs to ~/.agents/skills/ffmpeg-skill, the cross-client skills location. MCP server option: npx -y ffmpeg-skill mcp.
- **GSD Core** (free, No auth) — Get Shit Done — spec-driven development skills for Claude Code (context engineering + meta-prompting). Successor of the archived gsd-build/get-shit-done. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core
- **GStack** (free, No auth) — Garry Tan's (Y Combinator) exact Claude Code setup — 23 slash-command skills acting as CEO, designer, eng manager, release manager, doc engineer and QA. Needs Claude Code + Bun v1.4.2+; poor fit on a phone (Bun + browser steps). Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/garrytan/gstack
- **Hallmark** (free, No auth) — Anti-AI-slop design skill — 50 material themes, hard quality gates and a page linter so agent-built sites look designed, not generated; 755 openly licensed photos. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); browser-check (sloplint) needs desktop Chrome (unavailable on a phone) — core skill works without it. Docs: https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark
- **Last30Days** (free, No auth) — Researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket and the web, then synthesises a grounded summary of the last 30 days. Needs Python + Go; Reddit/HN keyless, X/YouTube/TikTok need API keys. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill Use cases: Product research — grounded last-30-days briefs from Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News; Topic research — what people actually say about a product or topic right now. Install (npx-skills): npx skills add mvanhorn/last30days-skill -g | Runtime: Node.js 22.20+ for the installer; Python 3 + Go for the engine | Requires: none for Reddit/Hacker News; X/YouTube/TikTok need API keys | First run: /last30days <topic> | Note: Untested in Termux. Claude Code route: /plugin marketplace add mvanhorn/last30days-skill. Direct engine: python3 skills/last30days/scripts/last30days.py "<topic>".
- **Marketing Skills** (free, No auth) — Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents — CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics and growth engineering. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- **Open SEO MCP Skills** (free, No auth) — Free SEO + GEO skills (audit, keywords, rank tracking, backlinks, AI visibility) on your real Search Console/Analytics data via a free hosted MCP server. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); skills are Markdown, pasteable into any agent; GSC/GA4-based skills free — free allowance for DataForSEO-backed skills unverified. Docs: https://github.com/Ryze-AI-Adgent/open-seo-mcp-skills
- **Ponytail** (free, No auth) — Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev — the best code is the code you never wrote. YAGNI-style skill; install only from the official repo/npm, never .exe/.dll. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail
- **Scientific Agent Skills** (free, No auth) — 177 validated science skills + 100+ scientific databases — biology, chemistry, medicine, drug discovery. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity and the open Agent Skills standard. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
- **Taste Skill** (free, No auth) — Design-taste skill for coding agents — art direction, real openly licensed reference photos and a browser self-check instead of generic AI pages. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); scripts need Node 22+; browser-check needs desktop Chrome (unavailable on a phone) — core skill works without it. Docs: https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill
- **Unslop** (free, No auth) — Skill that audits vibecoded, AI-looking UI and redesigns it in nine passes so it stops looking AI-generated. Free tier: Free, open-source (CC-BY-4.0, incl. commercial use, attribution required); install by git clone + copy into ~/.claude/skills. Docs: https://github.com/heydamir/unslop

## Books (4)

- **Google Books** (free, API key) — Search books, previews, and metadata from Google Books. Free tier: Free key; no published limit. Docs: https://developers.google.com/books/docs/v1/getting_started
- **Gutendex** (free, No auth) — Project Gutenberg ebooks as JSON: search by author, topic, or language. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://gutendex.com/
- **Open Library** (free, No auth) — Book metadata, covers, and search from the Internet Archive's Open Library. Free tier: Free, no key; 1 req/sec (3/sec identified). Docs: https://openlibrary.org/dev/docs/api/ Try it: https://openlibrary.org/search.json?q=the+lord+of+the+rings&limit=1
- **PoetryDB** (free, No auth) — Classic poems searchable by author, title or line, with full poem text. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://github.com/thundercomb/poetrydb#readme Try it: https://poetrydb.org/random

## Cryptocurrency (5)

- **Binance** (free, No auth) — Binance public market data: prices, trades, and order books. Free tier: Free; 6,000 weight/min per IP. Docs: https://binance-docs.github.io/apidocs/spot/en/
- **CoinCap** (freemium, API key) — Crypto prices and market data for 2,000+ assets. Free tier: Free key; 500 credits/mo, 5 req/min. Docs: https://docs.coincap.io/
- **CoinGecko** (freemium, No auth) — Crypto prices, market data, and exchange info for thousands of coins. Free tier: Free; 10,000 calls/mo, 100/min. Docs: https://docs.coingecko.com/ Try it: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd
- **CoinLore** (free, No auth) — Crypto prices, market cap, and historical data. Free tier: Free, no key; ~1 req/sec recommended. Docs: https://www.coinlore.com/cryptocurrency-data-api Try it: https://api.coinlore.net/api/tickers/?start=0&limit=1
- **CoinPaprika** (freemium, No auth) — Crypto prices, market caps, and coin metadata. Free tier: Free, no key; 20,000 calls/mo, personal use. Docs: https://api.coinpaprika.com/ Try it: https://api.coinpaprika.com/v1/tickers/btc-bitcoin

## Currency Exchange (3)

- **Currency-api** (free, No auth) — Free currency exchange rates for 200+ currencies, updated daily. Free tier: Free, no key; no rate limits. Docs: https://github.com/fawazahmed0/exchange-api Try it: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fawazahmed0/currency-api@latest/v1/currencies/usd.json
- **ExchangeRate-API** (freemium, API key) — Exchange rates for 160+ currencies, updated daily. Free tier: Free key; 1,500 req/mo. Docs: https://www.exchangerate-api.com/docs/free
- **Frankfurter** (free, No auth) — Foreign exchange rates and currency conversion, powered by the ECB. Free tier: Free, no key; no quotas, no daily/monthly caps. Docs: https://www.frankfurter.app/docs/ Try it: https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/latest?base=USD&symbols=EUR

## Date & Time (1)

- **Date Nager** (free, No auth) — Public holidays for 100+ countries. Free tier: Free, no key; no rate limits, unlimited. Docs: https://date.nager.at/ Try it: https://date.nager.at/api/v3/publicholidays/2026/US

## Development (10)

- **GitHub REST API** (free, No auth) — Repos, issues, users, and search across GitHub. Free tier: 60 req/hour without a key; 5,000/hour with a free token. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest Try it: https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World
- **GitLab** (free, No auth) — Projects, issues, and merge requests on GitLab. Free tier: Free, no key; 60 req/hr per IP. Docs: https://docs.gitlab.com/api/ Try it: https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects?per_page=1
- **httpbin** (free, No auth) — HTTP request and response testing service. Free tier: Free, no key; ~17 req/sec per IP. Docs: https://httpbin.org/ Try it: https://httpbin.org/get
- **Iconify** (free, No auth) — Over 300,000 open-source icons as SVG data, searchable by icon set. Free tier: Free, no key; fair-use limits, no numbers published. Docs: https://iconify.design/docs/api/ Try it: https://api.iconify.design/mdi.json?icons=home
- **JSONPlaceholder** (free, No auth) — Fake REST API for testing and prototyping (posts, users, todos). Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/ Try it: https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1
- **OSV** (free, No auth) — Database of open-source software vulnerabilities — look up a CVE or OSV ID. Free tier: Free, no key; no rate limits. Docs: https://google.github.io/osv.dev/api/ Try it: https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2021-44228
- **PyPI** (free, No auth) — Python package metadata, versions, and download stats. Free tier: Free, no key; no rate limit at the edge. Docs: https://docs.pypi.org/ Try it: https://pypi.org/pypi/requests/json
- **Shields.io** (free, No auth) — Status badges for READMEs: builds, coverage, versions, and more. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://shields.io/
- **Stack Exchange** (free, No auth) — Questions, answers, and users across Stack Exchange sites. Free tier: Free, no key; 300 req/day without key, 10,000 with a free key. Docs: https://api.stackexchange.com/docs Try it: https://api.stackexchange.com/2.3/questions?order=desc&sort=activity&site=stackoverflow&pagesize=1
- **UI Avatars** (free, No auth) — Avatar images with user initials, generated from a URL. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://ui-avatars.com/

Docs: https://en.wiktionary.org/w/api.php Try it: https://en.wiktionary.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch=hello&format=json&origin=*

## Free Agent Tools (25)

- **Agentic AI Starters** (free, No auth) — Blueprints and starter templates for building AI agents. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); blueprints only — the Apify + OpenAI stack in the examples is paid. Docs: https://github.com/cporter202/agentic-ai-starters
- **awesome-freellm-apis** (free, No auth) — Curated list of 311+ free LLM APIs and AI API keys from 22 providers (Gemini, NVIDIA NIM, Groq, OpenRouter…), with one-click setup for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); a curated list, not a router — each API's own free tier applies. Docs: https://github.com/open-free-llm-api/awesome-freellm-apis
- **Bifrost** (free, No auth) — Go AI gateway (LLM + MCP + agent gateway): one OpenAI-compatible API across 23+ providers, with failover, load balancing and semantic caching. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); self-hosted (Docker/server). Bring your own provider keys. Docs: https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost
- **Claude Code Action** (free, No auth) — Official Anthropic GitHub Action — run Claude Code on issues and PRs from a comment. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); runs on GitHub Actions, not on the phone — needs a Claude API key or subscription (usage is paid). Docs: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action
- **Claude-Mem** (free, No auth) — Persistent memory layer for coding agents — records sessions, compresses with AI, injects context into future runs; works with OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and more. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); compression uses your own key (free gateways work); hosted CMEM Pro (cloud sync) is paid, engine stays free. Docs: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem
- **Context7** (free, No auth) — Up-to-date documentation MCP server — gives agents current library docs instead of stale training data. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT). Docs: https://github.com/upstash/context7
- **FreeLLMAPI** (free, No auth) — Self-hosted router aggregating 87 free LLM providers (1,313 endpoints) behind one OpenAI-compatible /v1 API — smart routing, auto-failover, encrypted keys, web dashboard; desktop + Android apps. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); bring your own free provider keys (10.1B tokens/mo assumes all accounts set up). Live catalog $19/yr or $49 once — free gets a monthly snapshot. Personal experimentation only, not production. Official Termux guide (experimental, Node 22.13+) — untested by us. Docs: https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi Use cases: Free LLM tokens — one API for 87 free providers, fixes the token problem; Free models for coding agents — point OpenCode at http://localhost:3001/v1. Install (source): pkg update; pkg upgrade -y; pkg install -y nodejs-lts git; git clone https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi.git; cd freellmapi; npm install --no-audit --no-fund; npm run dev | Runtime: Node.js 22.13+ (Node 24 LTS recommended; Termux ships 26) | Requires: About 1 GB free storage; Termux from F-Droid (Play Store build is outdated); free provider API keys, added on the Keys page at http://localhost:5173 | First run: npm run dev, then open http://localhost:5173 and add provider keys; the unified key works at http://localhost:3001/v1 | Note: Official Termux guide is experimental and community-supported, untested by us. The Docker one-liner does NOT work on a phone. Use termux-wake-lock to keep the server awake; never expose the dashboard to the internet.
- **GitDiagram** (free, No auth) — Turns any GitHub repo into an interactive diagram or explainer video. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); diagrams are generated via an external AI API — repo content leaves your machine. Docs: https://github.com/ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram
- **GitHub MCP Server** (free, No auth) — Official GitHub MCP server — lets agents read repos, issues and PRs and automate GitHub workflows. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); needs a free GitHub personal access token. Docs: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server
- **Gitleaks** (free, No auth) — Secret scanner — finds passwords, API keys and tokens in git repos, directories and stdin before they get committed. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); build from source in Termux (pkg install golang + make build); maintenance mode (security patches only). Docs: https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks
- **GitMCP** (free, No auth) — Instant remote MCP server for any public GitHub repo — swap github.com for gitmcp.io and your agent reads the repo in context. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); public repos only — serves repo content to your agent, so treat untrusted repos with care (prompt-injection risk). Docs: https://github.com/idosal/git-mcp
- **Langfuse** (free, No auth) — Open-source observability for LLM apps and agents — traces, evals, prompt management and cost tracking. Free tier: Free, open-core (MIT core; enterprise features under a separate licence); self-hosted free. Docs: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse
- **Lazygit** (free, No auth) — Simple terminal UI for git — stage hunks, interactive rebase, cherry-pick, worktrees and commit graph from the terminal. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); official Termux package (apt install lazygit); interactive human TUI, not agent-drivable. Docs: https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit
- **LiteLLM** (free, No auth) — Open-source AI gateway: call 100+ LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq…) through one OpenAI-compatible API, with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing and fallbacks. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT core; enterprise/ directory under a separate licence). Library path (pip install litellm) is phone-usable; full proxy is self-hosted. Docs: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm
- **Manifest** (free, No auth) — TypeScript LLM gateway ("Manifest") built for agents that don't break: failover-focused routing across providers behind one API. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); self-hosted, cloud-deploy oriented (Render/Railway/AWS/GCP one-click). Newer project (2026, MNFST Inc.). Docs: https://github.com/mnfst/llm-gateway
- **Magpie** (free, No auth) — Local model router for every agent — point Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode at any provider (incl. free gateways) from one Termux-friendly gateway, with auto-failover when a quota runs out. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); bring your own free key — magpie itself grants no models. Docs: https://github.com/yetone/magpie
- **MCP Servers (Official)** (free, No auth) — Official Model Context Protocol reference servers: filesystem, GitHub, fetch, memory, time, sequential thinking and more. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0; transitioning from MIT). Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers
- **Mem0** (free, No auth) — Memory layer for AI agents — remembers user preferences and context across sessions. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); self-hosted free, hosted platform is paid. Docs: https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0
- **OmniRoute** (free, No auth) — Free multi-provider AI gateway — one endpoint for 394 providers (150+ free) and ~1,400 models, quota-aware auto-fallback, token compression. Runs in Termux (pkg install nodejs && npx -y omniroute). Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); bring your own free provider accounts (150+ free tiers incl. DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Gemini); runs on your phone, no root. Docs: https://github.com/cheaper-inference/OmniRoute
- **Portkey Gateway** (free, No auth) — Open-source AI gateway (TypeScript): one API for 250+ LLMs with routing, fallbacks, load balancing, guardrails and caching; npm-installable. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); self-host the gateway. Hosted Portkey plans are paid. Note: the project's own pages disagree on model count (repo says 1,600+, README says 250+). Docs: https://github.com/Portkey-AI/gateway
- **Skill Seekers** (free, No auth) — Turn docs sites, GitHub repos, PDFs, videos and wikis into structured AI skills — 18 source types, 22 export targets, CLI + MCP server. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); pip install skill-seekers, pure Python CLI, no server/GPU; AI-assisted generation may need a model key. Docs: https://github.com/yusufkaraaslan/Skill_Seekers
- **SkillSpector** (free, No auth) — NVIDIA's open-source security scanner for agent skills — 71 vulnerability patterns across 17 categories, 0-100 risk score; never executes the skill. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0); static scan needs no API key; Alpha stage. Docs: https://github.com/NVIDIA/skillspector
- **Tavily MCP** (free, No auth) — Web-search MCP server (search + extract) for agents — the search backend OpenCode lacks on the phone. Free tier: Free, open-source (MIT); needs a free Tavily API key — 1,000 credits/mo, no card. Docs: https://github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-mcp Use cases: Web search for agents — gives OpenCode the search it lacks; Data scraping and product research — search, extract, map and crawl pages. Install (remote-mcp): Add remote MCP server: https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/?tavilyApiKey=<your-api-key> | Runtime: none — remote server, nothing to install locally | Requires: free Tavily API key from tavily.com (1,000 credits/mo, no card) | First run: use the tavily-search tool | Note: Tools: tavily-search, tavily-extract, tavily-map, tavily-crawl. The key can also go in an Authorization: Bearer header. A local npx install exists but the remote URL is the documented path.
- **Xerj** (free, No auth) — Local-first AI search engine + MCP server for agents: BM25, vector and hybrid code & docs search from one static binary, offline by default. Free tier: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0 engine); static arm64 binary or build from source; neural Query-1 model in release binaries is proprietary (core engine open). Docs: https://github.com/xerj-org/xerj
- **yt-dlp** (free, No auth) — Feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader for 1000+ sites. Free tier: Free, open-source (Unlicense); pip-installable in Termux, no key, no account. Docs: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp

## FreeLLM API (10)

- **Google AI Studio** (freemium, API key) — Google's Gemini API via AI Studio: free tier on Flash/Pro models, no card, per-project limits. Free tier: Free tier, no card, no expiry: per-model limits shown in AI Studio (not published in public docs) — reports conflict on 2.5 Flash daily cap (500–1,500 RPD); check aistudio.google.com/rate-limit. Free-tier data may be used to train models. Docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits
- **Groq** (freemium, API key) — Fastest open-model inference on custom LPU chips; free tier covers gpt-oss and Qwen chat models, OpenAI-compatible. Free tier: Free tier, no card: per-model limits — chat models (gpt-oss-120b/20b, qwen3.8-27b) 30 RPM / 1,000 RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD; Llama chat models are Enterprise-only since Aug 2026. Docs: https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits
- **hcnsec** (freemium, API key) — Xinjiang Huancheng public-welfare gateway: one OpenAI-compatible key for Chinese models (DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen, Kimi, Step, MiniMax); free layer via signup + daily check-in. Free tier: Free via registration credits + daily sign-in quota (amounts not published); free layer incl. DeepSeek-V4-Pro/Flash, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, GLM-5.3-Flash — full GLM 5.3 is on the paid SVIP layer. Third-party proxy, NOT a permanent free tier. Docs: https://api.hcnsec.cn/free-api/
- **Kilo Code Gateway** (freemium, No auth) — OpenAI-compatible gateway from the open-source Kilo Code agent; free models incl. the kilo-auto/free auto-router, no key needed. Free tier: Free models incl. kilo-auto/free router, no key, no signup: 200 requests/hour per IP (anonymous); Auto Free may route to providers that log prompts — no sensitive data. Docs: https://kilo.ai/docs/gateway/models-and-providers
- **LLM7.io** (freemium, API key) — One-key OpenAI-compatible LLM API; free token covers chat, image and video models. Free tier: Free token: 100,000 tokens per 24 hours; 60 RPM / 250 req/hour; Pro $12/mo for more. Free quota may shrink without notice. Docs: https://docs.llm7.io Try it: https://api.llm7.io/v1/models
- **NVIDIA Build** (freemium, API key) — NVIDIA's hosted NIM endpoints: 70+ open-weight models incl. DeepSeek and GLM on one OpenAI-compatible key. Free tier: Free endpoints (70+ models incl. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3): published ceiling 40 RPM / 10,000 req/day; BUT phone verification blocks Bangladesh (+880) — not offered there per NVIDIA's own list; manual verification via help@build.nvidia.com is the official route. Prototyping/evaluation only, no production SLA. Docs: https://build.nvidia.com
- **OpenRouter** (freemium, API key) — One-key gateway to 600+ models; free :free models incl. GPT-OSS, Nemotron and Inkling, no card needed. Free tier: 25+ :free models: 20 RPM; 50 req/day free, 1,000 req/day after $10+ lifetime credit purchase. Docs: https://openrouter.ai/docs Try it: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models
- **OrcaRouter** (freemium, API key) — One-key OpenAI-compatible gateway to 200+ models with auto-failover; free models incl. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free and GLM 5.3 Flash Free. Free tier: Hacker plan free forever, no card: $0 free models incl. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free + GLM 5.3 Flash Free; 10 RPM / 50 RPD (20 RPM / 800 RPD after $20+ lifetime purchases); lineup rotates. Docs: https://docs.orcarouter.ai Try it: https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1/models
- **Pollinations** (freemium, No auth) — Open-source gen-AI gateway: keyless text + image generation by URL; new API uses Pollen credits. Free tier: Legacy keyless text API (text.pollinations.ai, OpenAI-compatible, gpt-oss-20b): free, no signup — allowance not published; new gen.pollinations.ai API needs a key + Pollen credits (small free Quest Pollen). Free image lane ~1 image/45 sec per IP. Docs: https://pollinations.ai/docs Try it: https://text.pollinations.ai/models
- **UnoRouter** (freemium, API key) — One-key OpenAI-compatible gateway aggregating 150+ free models from ~50 providers; DeepSeek and GLM free. Free tier: 150+ :free models incl. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash + GLM 5.3 Flash: ~1 request/min per model per account, no daily cap; paid models pay-as-you-go from $1. Docs: https://unorouter.com/docs Try it: https://api.unorouter.com/v1/models

## Test Data (6)

- **DummyJSON** (free, No auth) — Fake JSON data: products, users, todos, and more. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://dummyjson.com/ Try it: https://dummyjson.com/products/1
- **Fake Store API** (free, No auth) — Fake store API: products, carts, and users for e-commerce mockups. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://fakestoreapi.com/ Try it: https://fakestoreapi.com/products/1
- **FakerAPI** (free, No auth) — Fake test data — people, companies, products, books and more in JSON. Free tier: Free, no key; max 1,000 rows per request. Docs: https://fakerapi.it/en Try it: https://fakerapi.it/api/v2/persons?_quantity=1
- **Quotable** (free, No auth) — Random quotes with authors and tags. Free tier: Free, no key; 180 req/min. Docs: https://github.com/lukePeavey/quotable Try it: https://quotable.vercel.app/random
- **Random User** (free, No auth) — Random user data generator for prototypes (names, photos, emails). Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://randomuser.me/ Try it: https://randomuser.me/api/?results=1
- **ReqRes** (freemium, API key) — Hosted fake REST API for testing (users, login, delayed responses). Free tier: Free key; 250 req/day. Docs: https://reqres.in/ Try it: https://reqres.in/api/users/2

## Translation (1)

- **LibreTranslate** (freemium, No auth) — Open-source machine translation, self-hostable or via the public instance. Free tier: Free to self-host; hosted API from $29/mo. Docs: https://libretranslate.com/docs/ Try it: https://libretranslate.com/languages

## Weather (4)

- **MET Norway** (free, No auth) — Weather forecasts from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute. Free tier: Free, no key; max 20 req/sec. Docs: https://api.met.no/ Try it: https://api.met.no/weatherapi/locationforecast/2.0/compact?lat=60.10&lon=9.58
- **Open-Meteo** (freemium, No auth) — Weather forecasts and historical weather, no key needed. Free tier: Free, no key; 10,000 calls/day (non-commercial). Docs: https://open-meteo.com/ Try it: https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=52.52&longitude=13.41&current=temperature_2m
- **OpenWeatherMap** (freemium, API key) — Current weather, forecasts, and historical data worldwide. Free tier: Free plan; 1,000 calls/day. Docs: https://openweathermap.org/api
- **wttr.in** (free, No auth) — Weather in the terminal and JSON, no key needed. Free tier: Free, no key; no published limit. Docs: https://github.com/chubin/wttr.in Try it: https://wttr.in/London?format=j1
